title: Nvidia taps ASE's SPIL for chip packaging in Arizona

sources.quote: NVIDIA is partnering with Amkor and SPIL for packaging and testing operations in Arizona.

explain: SPIL (Siliconware Precision Industries) is a subsidiary of ASE Technology, the world's largest chip packaging and testing company. Nvidia named it as a partner to package and test its chips in Arizona. No dollar amount was given.
